items.source: Set the KeyspacePopulator to execute during the bean destruction phase, cleaning up the keyspace and leaving it in a known state for others.
items.translation: 将KeyspacePopulator设置为在 Bean 销毁阶段执行，以清理 keyspace 并将其置于已知状态供其他组件使用。

items.source: Set the KeyspacePopulator to execute during the bean initialization phase.

items.source: Provides extensible support for initializing databases through scripts.
items.translation: 提供通过脚本初始化数据库的可扩展支持。
